request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause may cite more than one span (for example a statement in the program plus a field declaration in a copybook); judge it on all of its cited spans together. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

Rule BR-CBACT04C-001: Category balances are processed in account groups (control break on account ID)

### given[0]: Category balance records are read one at a time, in key order, from the category balance file, which is indexed and read sequentially. The record key starts with the account ID, so all categories for one account come in together.
fields=['TCATBAL-FILE', 'FD-TRAN-CAT-KEY', 'FD-TRANCAT-ACCT-ID', 'TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
    24        AUTHOR.        AWS.
    25        ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
    26        INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
    27        FILE-CONTROL.
>>  28            SELECT TCATBAL-FILE ASSIGN TO TCATBALF
>>  29                   ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED
>>  30                   ACCESS MODE  IS SEQUENTIAL
>>  31                   RECORD KEY   IS FD-TRAN-CAT-KEY
>>  32                   FILE STATUS  IS TCATBALF-STATUS.
    33 
    34            SELECT XREF-FILE ASSIGN TO   XREFFILE
    35                   ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED
    36                   ACCESS MODE  IS RANDOM
CBACT04C.cbl:
    57 
    58       *
    59        DATA DIVISION.
    60        FILE SECTION.
>>  61        FD  TCATBAL-FILE.
>>  62        01  FD-TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD.
>>  63            05 FD-TRAN-CAT-KEY.
>>  64               10 FD-TRANCAT-ACCT-ID             PIC 9(11).
>>  65               10 FD-TRANCAT-TYPE-CD             PIC X(02).
>>  66               10 FD-TRANCAT-CD                  PIC 9(04).
    67            05 FD-FD-TRAN-CAT-DATA               PIC X(33).
    68 
    69        FD  XREF-FILE.
    70        01  FD-XREFFILE-REC.
CBACT04C.cbl:
   321                PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
   322            END-IF
   323            EXIT.
   324       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
>> 325        1000-TCATBALF-GET-NEXT.
>> 326            READ TCATBAL-FILE INTO TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD.
   327            IF  TCATBALF-STATUS  = '00'
   328                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
   329            ELSE
   330                IF  TCATBALF-STATUS  = '10'

### given[1] (already verified; context only, no verdict needed): At program start the last-seen account number is spaces and the first-time flag is 'Y'.

### when[0] (already verified; context only, no verdict needed): A category balance record is read and its account ID differs from the last-seen account number.

### then[0]: If this is not the first account group, 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT runs for the account loaded before: it adds the accumulated interest total to the account's current balance, sets the current-cycle credit and debit to 0, and rewrites the account record. On the first group the first-time flag is only set to 'N'.
fields=['WS-FIRST-TIME', 'WS-TOTAL-INT', 'ACCT-CURR-BAL', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT', 'FD-ACCTFILE-REC', 'ACCOUNT-RECORD'] literals=['Y', 'N']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   191                    IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
   192                      ADD 1 TO WS-RECORD-COUNT
   193                      DISPLAY TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
   194                      IF TRANCAT-ACCT-ID NOT= WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
>> 195                        IF WS-FIRST-TIME NOT = 'Y'
>> 196                           PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT
>> 197                        ELSE
>> 198                           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FIRST-TIME
>> 199                        END-IF
   200                        MOVE 0 TO WS-TOTAL-INT
   201                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
   202                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
   203                        PERFORM 1100-GET-ACCT-DATA
CBACT04C.cbl:
   346                END-IF
   347            END-IF
   348            EXIT.
   349       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
>> 350        1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT.
>> 351       * Update the balances in account record to reflect posted trans.
>> 352            ADD WS-TOTAL-INT  TO ACCT-CURR-BAL
>> 353            MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
>> 354            MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
>> 355 
>> 356            REWRITE FD-ACCTFILE-REC FROM  ACCOUNT-RECORD
   357            IF  ACCTFILE-STATUS  = '00'
   358                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
   359            ELSE
   360                MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT

### then[1] (already verified; context only, no verdict needed): The interest total is reset to 0 and the last-seen account number is set to the new account ID.

### then[2] (already verified; context only, no verdict needed): The account record for the new account ID is read by key from the account file into ACCOUNT-RECORD.

### then[3]: The card cross-reference for the account is read through the account-ID alternate key. Its card number is the one later copied into the card number of each interest transaction.
fields=['TRANCAT-ACCT-ID', 'FD-XREF-ACCT-ID', 'CARD-XREF-RECORD', 'XREF-CARD-NUM', 'TRAN-CARD-NUM'] literals=[]

>> 395             KEY IS FD-XREF-ACCT-ID
>> 396                INVALID KEY
>> 397                   DISPLAY 'ACCOUNT NOT FOUND: ' FD-XREF-ACCT-ID
>> 398            END-READ

>> 495            MOVE XREF-CARD-NUM        TO TRAN-CARD-NUM

   499 

### then[4] (already verified; context only, no verdict needed): For every category balance record, whether or not the account changed, the rate lookup key is built from the account's group ID and the record's category code and type code, and the interest rate is looked up.

### then[5] (already verified; context only, no verdict needed): Interest is calculated (and the fee step run) only when the interest rate found is not zero. Records with a zero rate add nothing to the account's interest total.

Give verdicts only for the clauses that are not marked already verified.
